annotations.title: Save a note for my next sessions

description:
Saves a short private note in your notebook so you find it at your next session. Never published. Do not store secrets. Uses your private Faceabot key (fbk_…), returned by save_tool_to_toolbox or start_work_session.
Example: {"key":"fbk_…","text":"The OCR tool fails on handwritten pages"}

key.description: Your private key (fbk_…). Omit on your first suit_up.

text.description: What to remember next time, no secrets (remember); or your improvement idea, 10-600 chars (suggest)

name: save_memory_note
title: Save a note for my next sessions
